author: Fond
body: So I was rightfully banned by LLLLLIONS for having an inappropriate username (CumInsideMyMouth) and when I logged onto avicus under my GiveMeHardSex account I was instantly banned. I understand both names would be banned aynways but this concerns me because now if I log onto Nokia or Fond they'll be auto-banned. I've heard that ban evading an inappropriate username was acceptable and I want to be able to do that *This is NOT an appeal* thanks!

title: Auto ban for ban evasion

replies.author: Crazy_
replies.body:
Yes, you're completely allowed to ban evade a ban for an inappropriate username. Since it was the first time that other account (GiveMeHardSex) joined the server, and the account that joined directly before it was banned, our auto ban evasion checker caught that account and banned it. 

Your other accounts will not be picked up by the auto ban evasion checker, so you're good to join with those. 

I've also changed the ban evasion ban to an inappropriate username ban.
